% A one-page CV template written for Foja's tests, in the manner of the common LaTeX résumés.
% MIT No Attribution: use it for anything, no credit needed.
\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage[a4paper,margin=18mm]{geometry}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}

\definecolor{accent}{HTML}{1F4E79}
\pagestyle{empty}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\titleformat{\section}{\color{accent}\large\bfseries\scshape}{}{0pt}{}[\titlerule]
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{10pt}{6pt}

\newcommand{\cvheader}[4]{%
  \begin{center}
    {\Huge\bfseries #1}\\[4pt]
    #2 \quad\textbar\quad \href{mailto:#3}{#3} \quad\textbar\quad \href{https://#4}{#4}
  \end{center}}
\newcommand{\cventry}[4]{%
  \textbf{#1} \hfill #3\\
  \textit{#2} \hfill \textit{#4}\par}
\def\cvdetail#1{\item #1}
\newenvironment{cvitems}{\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=12pt,itemsep=1pt,topsep=2pt]}{\end{itemize}\vspace{4pt}}

\begin{document}
\cvheader{Ana Pérez}{Rosario, Argentina}{ana@example.com}{ana.example.com}

\section{Experience}
\cventry{Backend developer}{Example Co.}{03/2021 -- Present}{Rosario}
\begin{cvitems}
  \cvdetail{Designed the billing service and its API.}
  \cvdetail{Cut the nightly import from two hours to ten minutes.}
\end{cvitems}
\cventry{Teaching assistant}{National University}{03/2018 -- 12/2020}{Rosario}
\begin{cvitems}
  \cvdetail{Taught the practical classes of Algebra.}
\end{cvitems}

\section{Education}
\cventry{Computer Science degree}{National University}{03/2015 -- 12/2020}{Rosario}

\section{Skills}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=12pt]
  \item Python, TypeScript, SQL
  \item Spanish (native), English (C1)
\end{itemize}
\end{document}
